messages:
lina (partnerships): heads up — SecureVault (SI partner) wants to land their KMS/HSM-backed secrets integration in the Redwood marketplace. proposing a soft launch + joint blog in the week of May 9. need alignment on technical gating + legal embargo.

mike (security): +1. main blocker for us: BYOK support + proof of envelope key wrapping. can SecureVault provide a KMS-compatible wrap/unwrap flow? also need an ATO checklist for enterprise customers.

jordan (product): timeline wise May 9 is tight. we need the console UI tile + onboarding flow done, and marketplace listing metadata. do we have vendor assets?

lina (partnerships): vendor said assets ready next Tue. they also want a quick integration test with our staging marketplace tomorrow afternoon.

bryan (eng): I can stand up the staging connector for them. what endpoints should we validate? my checklist: auth SAML/SCIM for provisioning, KMS wrap/unwrap, secret sync API, and audit log events.

mike (security): yep. add key rotation test and HSM-backed signing of audit events. also capture latency profile for wrap op (<50ms target).

jordan (product): marketing need to know the exact features for the listing: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM user provisioning, KMS (BYOK + HSM), secret sync, rotation hooks, SOC2-compatible audit logs. if any feature is delayed we should mark it as "beta" in listing.

lina (partnerships): action items: 1) bryan/eng to run staging test with SecureVault tomorrow 2pm PT 2) security to confirm BYOK acceptance criteria by EOD 3) legal to confirm embargo window — marketing hold until we say go.

bryan (eng): copied. i'll send an invite to SecureVault + deploy-bot will auto-provision a staging tenant.

deploy-bot: provisioning request queued: tenant sv-partner-test-03. ephemeral creds expiring in 72h. link: https://staging.console.redwood/test/tenants/sv-partner-test-03

mike (security): quick note on BYOK: acceptable flow is Envelope Encryption: vendor wraps customer DEK with a KMS wrapping key we control. need KMS API compatibility (Encrypt/Decrypt) and HSM attestation doc. if vendor insists on managing wrapping keys we need contract-level warranties.

lina (partnerships): @mike can you draft the short acceptance checklist? i'll share it with SecureVault and legal.

mike (security): will do. rough checklist coming now:
```
- KMS wrap/unwrap API: success/failure codes defined
- HSM attestation: hardware cert and firmware versions
- Key rotation test: rotate wrapping key and ensure rewraps succeed
- Audit events: wrap/unwrap + rotation logged with requestor identity
- Latency: median wrap <50ms in staging; p99 <150ms
- SCIM: provisioning + deprovisioning test
- SSO: SAML assertion test with attribute mappings
```

jordan (product): perfect. i'll prep marketplace metadata template and set feature flags accordingly.

lina (partnerships): legal asked: do we plan a joint press? SecureVault wants a co-branded blog + webinar in week after launch. legal needs embargo end date. propose embargo end = May 16 00:00 PT. agree?

mike (security): fine from sec POV, assuming acceptance checklist green.

bryan (eng): fine. engineering push freeze window: May 6-8 we should avoid breaking infra changes. heads-up to infra.

lina (partnerships): summary: staging test tomorrow 2pm PT (bryan), security checklist to be shared today (mike), legal to confirm embargo (lina -> legal), marketing hold until May 16. i'll run a sync after staging test and update the thread. :white_check_mark:

mike (security): tagging follow-ups: @bryan please capture a HAR for wrap calls and include metrics. and notify me if p99 >150ms.

bryan (eng): will attach results here after test.

deploy-bot: invite accepted: securevault@sivendor.com added to tenant sv-partner-test-03.
